essence: The practitioner can accomplish both the revival of the dead and the animation of an image through the prescribed rite.
Through the practice one certainly gains the power to attract leaves, flowers, fruits, and the like.
The practitioner receives one rūpyaka daily from Maṇibhadra.
Daily recitation of a thousand must be continued until a dream arises.
Upon completing a hundred thousand recitations, the accomplished ocean-servant bestows a gift.
